get.summary: Get a paginated list of learning courses
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of learning courses.

**Automatic role-based filtering:**
- **Admin / Academic Affairs**: Sees all courses.
- **Lecturer**: Automatically filtered to courses where `lecturer_id` matches their employee profile. Cannot see courses of other lecturers.
- **Student**: Automatically filtered to courses whose `course_section_id` matches the course sections they are registered in (via `course_registrations`). Returns empty if the student has no registered sections.

> The `lecturer_id` and `visibility` query parameters will be **ignored or overridden** for non-admin users.

parameters.name: lecturer_id
parameters.description: Filter by lecturer employee profile ID. **Admin only** — overridden automatically for Lecturers.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Filter courses starting on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Filter courses ending on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

message.example: Learning courses retrieved successfully.

post.description:
Creates a new learning course.

**Required permission:** `learning_courses.create`

**Notes:**
- `code` must be unique across the system.
- `thumbnail`, if an image file is uploaded, will be automatically converted to **WebP** format.
- `lecturer_id` must reference a valid `employee_profiles.id`.
- `course_section_id`, if provided, must reference an existing course section.

description.example: This course covers modern web development techniques.

thumbnail.description: Course cover image (auto-converted to WebP). Supported: jpg, png, gif, webp

course_section_id.description: Linked course section ID (students enrolled in this section can access the course)

lecturer_id.description: Employee profile ID (`employee_profiles.id`) of the assigned lecturer

end_date.description: Course end date (must be after start_date)

enrollment_type.description:
Enrollment type:
- `self_enrollment`: Students can self-enroll
- `invitation`: By invitation only
- `course_section`: Linked to a course section (automatic enrollment)

visibility.description:
Visibility:
- `public`: Visible to all authenticated users
- `private`: Visible to assigned lecturer and admins only

status.description:
Course status:
- `active`: Active and accessible
- `inactive`: Temporarily disabled
- `archived`: Archived, read-only

get.summary: Get a learning course by ID
get.description:
Returns the details of a specific learning course.

**Access control:**
- **Admin / Academic Affairs**: Always allowed.
- **Lecturer**: Allowed only if they are the assigned lecturer of this course.
- **Student**: Allowed only if they are registered in the course's linked course section (`course_section_id`). Returns `403` if not enrolled.
- **Others**: Requires `learning_courses.view` permission.

message.example: Learning course retrieved successfully.

403.description: Forbidden — not the assigned lecturer, or student is not enrolled in the linked course section

put.description:
Updates an existing learning course. All fields are optional (partial update supported).

**Access control:**
- **Assigned Lecturer**: Can update their own course.
- **User with** `learning_courses.update` **permission**: Can update any course.

**Notes:**
- If a new `thumbnail` file is uploaded, the old thumbnail will be **deleted from storage**.
- Changing `course_section_id` affects which students can access the course.

thumbnail.description: New cover image (old image will be deleted)

message.example: Learning course updated successfully.

403.description: Forbidden — not the assigned lecturer or insufficient permission

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a learning course.

**Access control:**
- **Assigned Lecturer**: Can delete their own course.
- **User with** `learning_courses.delete` **permission**: Can delete any course.

**Notes:**
- This is a **soft delete** — data is not permanently removed from the database.
- The course `thumbnail` image will be **permanently deleted** from storage.
- The course `code` will be renamed to `{code}_del_{id}` to prevent unique constraint conflicts when recreating a course with the same code.

message.example: Learning course deleted successfully.

tags.name: Learning Courses
tags.description:
Manage **Learning Courses** in the LMS (Learning Management System).

A learning course is the main unit for organizing online teaching content, including course materials, assignments, and course modules.

**Access control by role:**
- **Admin / Academic Affairs**: Full access to all courses (view, create, update, delete).
- **Lecturer**: Can only view and manage courses they are assigned to (`lecturer_id`).
- **Student**: Can only view courses linked to their enrolled course section (`course_section_id` via `course_registrations`).

**Note:** The `lecturer_id` and `course_section_ids` filters are **automatically injected** by the server based on the authenticated user's role. Clients should not rely on manually passing these to control access.
